tool.description: Adjust the brightness and contrast of an image by signed amounts. brightness is -255..255 (negative darkens, positive brightens); contrast is -100..100 (negative flattens, positive increases); 0/0 leaves the image unchanged. Contrast is applied around mid-gray, then brightness. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

brightness.description: Brightness adjustment, -255 to 255 (negative darkens, positive brightens; 0 = no change).

contrast.description: Contrast adjustment, -100 to 100 (negative flattens, positive increases; 0 = no change).
